sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
भूगोल

  • वर्तमान केरल और कोंगु क्षेत्र (तमिलनाडु) में केंद्रित।
  • राजधानी: वंची (करूर/मुज़िरिस)।
  • प्रमुख बंदरगाह: मुज़िरिस (मुचिरी), एक वैश्विक समुद्री व्यापार केंद्र।

व्यक्तित्व

  • उतियन चेरानाथन: सबसे शुरुआती ज्ञात राजा।
  • नेदुनजेरल आदन: यवनों को हराने के लिए प्रसिद्ध।
  • सेनगुट्टुवन: 'लाल चेर', सिलापादिकारम के नायक।
  • राजनीतिक संरचना:
    • वंशानुगत उत्तराधिकार के साथ राजतंत्र।
    • राजाओं से जुड़ी दैवीय स्थिति।
    • 'मुवेंदार' (तीन ताज वाले राजा) दक्षिण भारत के आर्थिक संसाधनों को नियंत्रित करते थे।
  • अर्थव्यवस्था:
    • रोमनों के साथ व्यापार: काली मिर्च (यवन प्रिया), सोना और मोती।
    • कृषि: धान और मसालों की खेती मुख्य आधार थी।
शासकप्रमुख उपलब्धि
उतियन चेरानाथनसबसे शुरुआती रिकॉर्ड किए गए राजा; कुरुक्षेत्र की सेनाओं को भोजन कराया (पौराणिक)।
सेनगुट्टुवनपत्तिनी पंथ (कण्णगी) की स्थापना की।

practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following ports belonged to the Cheras during the Sangam Age?
practiceQuestions.sol: Muziris and Tyndis were the primary ports of the Chera kingdom on the western coast.

practiceQuestions.q: Who was the author of the epic Silappadikaram?
practiceQuestions.sol: Ilango Adigal, a Chera prince and brother of King Senguttuvan, wrote Silappadikaram.

practiceQuestions.q: In ancient Roman accounts, which spice from the Chera kingdom was referred to as 'Yavanapriya'?
practiceQuestions.sol: Black Pepper was highly valued by Romans (Yavanas) and was named 'Yavanapriya' (loved by Yavanas).

mockTestQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Sangam Cheras:
1. They issued coins with their royal emblem of the Tiger.
2. The city of Madurai was the capital of the Chera kingdom.
3. The Cheras controlled the Kongu region in western Tamil Nadu.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mockTestQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect: the Chera emblem was the Bow and Arrow (Tiger was Cholas). Statement 2 is incorrect: Madurai was the capital of the Pandyas (Vanji/Karur was Cheras). Statement 3 is correct.

mockTestQuestions.q: With reference to ancient South Indian history, the term 'Keralaputras' mentioned in Ashokan rock edicts refers to which of the following?
mockTestQuestions.sol: Ashokan Rock Edict II refers to the Cheras on the Malabar Coast as Keralaputras.
